> Decentralized.Host — Signed-intent assignment with per-host local policy enforcement.
>> dh/v1 conformance spec with 136 test vectors and 17 chaos scenarios.
>
> Language: Go
> Focus: sovereign infrastructure, local admission control, distributed state
>
> Repo: https://github.com/CodesbyFebin/Decentralized-
> Stack: Ed25519, Raft, mTLS, WireGuard, BLAKE3, Merkle anti-entropy
>
> Claims:
> - Work proposed as signed intent; each host enforces local policy before execution
> - BLAKE3 content-addressed storage with Merkle anti-entropy for data consistency
> - Raft consensus + mTLS for control plane security
> - Userspace WireGuard with signed key bindings
> - dh/v1 conformance spec with 136 normative test vectors
> - Independent Python reference implementation
> - 17 chaos scenarios with invariant validation under traffic
> - Explicit state model: DESIRED ≠ ADMITTED ≠ EXECUTING ≠ OBSERVED ≠ VERIFIED
>
> Verify: AGENTS.md | specs/dh-v1.md | pkg/conformance | tests/chaos/
>
> Status: Milestones M1-M8 complete (conformance passing). Chaos testing active.
> Limitations: No silent task migration; all admission decisions are audited and host-enforced.
